answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one walnut weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 15 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 21 times the capital for one share. The sparrow report makes public the merge explicitly at each zephyr. The per-identity price is 110 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
